Arrests and Bail After Non-Vegetarian Party on Ganga River

Several individuals were arrested following a non-vegetarian food and beer party held on a boat in the Ganga River. The incident, which involved a boat reportedly belonging to a BJP councilor, led to the quick apprehension of the accused. However, those arrested were granted bail on the day immediately following their arrest.
